claim: report_render.py hard-fails render when an HMAC sidecar exists and signature verification fails
sub_question: When does report_render.py render hard-fail on ledger signature state?
evidence: After schema validation, if evidence-ledger.csv.hmac exists and _verify_signature returns false, render prints FAILED refusing to render and returns 1.
quote_or_anchor: error: ledger signature verification FAILED — refusing to render
notes: Primary hard-fail on ledger signature state during render when sidecar present but invalid/tampered (cmd_render ~L546-552).

claim: With --require-signature, render hard-fails via preflight when verification fails
sub_question: When does report_render.py render hard-fail on ledger signature state?
evidence: _required_signature_preflight returns False when _verify_signature fails; cmd_render returns 1 when require_sig and preflight fails.
quote_or_anchor: error: ledger signature verification FAILED - refusing to render
notes: Preflight path when --require-signature is set; also fails closed for missing ledger or missing sidecar (~L210-233, L522-523).

claim: Unsigned ledger without --require-signature only warns; does not hard-fail
sub_question: When does report_render.py render hard-fail on ledger signature state?
evidence: If no .hmac sidecar and require_signature is false, render emits a warning and continues rather than hard-failing.
quote_or_anchor: warning: ledger is not signed; rendering without signature verification
notes: Contrast: absence of signature is warning-only unless --require-signature forces preflight failure (~L553-557).
